notes.title: Kosmokrats - a post launch musical party!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/56Cm1X8/Kosmokrats-Steam-News-06-04-2021.png[/img]

Hello Comrades and welcome to a special post as we celebrate all things Kosmokrats now that the game has been released on PC and [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/kosmokrats-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url].

🌠 Please enjoy this beautiful musical tribute to Kosmokrats ft Val 9000 and Bill Nighy 🌠

[previewyoutube=SzeIAIKhcoc;full][/previewyoutube]

Kosmokrats launched (in many ways) on PC, November 5th. The road to launch was as zany as the game itself.

We worked with brilliant voice actors such as Alec Newman (Boris) and Sooz Kempner (Val 9000) to bring the characters of the game alive. And of course, Hollywood star [url=https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0631490/]Bill Nighy[/url] joined the cast as the somewhat sarcastic, sometimes motivating narrator/voice in your head.

We also sponsored the Jelle's Marble Runs - Marbula One event, proudly taking the torch from the previous sponsor at the time - John Oliver's Last Week Tonight.

We want to say a big thank you to everyone that has played the game so far and took the time to leave a review! 💖

[h1]Reddit AMA[/h1]
👨‍🚀 At 15:00 GMT today (08/04) Carl from Pixel Delusion will be participating in an [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/NintendoSwitch/comments/mmtoiu/ama_kosmokrats_by_pixel_delusion/]AMA over at r/NintendoSwitch[/url]

Oh and in case you missed it Nintendo featured Kosmokrats in its eShop highlight video for March.

[previewyoutube=GUNY3O46mbg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Is this the end?[/h2]
No comrade this is not the end. Post-launch we added [b]Revisionist History[/b] mode to the game. It basically works like a checkpoint system where you can rewind to any previous checkpoint. 

This lets you go back and try different approaches such as "[i]What happens if I don't save *spoiler* this time?[/i]" or "[i]I think I'll go to Jupiter instead of Mars[/i]"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36868091/0c4f26e77ec4ef850795d61a2b90ae5c03cad1b8.png[/img]

You can find out even more [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1204410/announcements/detail/3041589319527775411]here[/url].

We have some big gameplay updates coming, one that will really put your couch to good use (hint hint).

Once again thank you for your support and please stay with us on our journey to the stars and beyond

notes.title: Kosmokrats has a new game mode that allows you to mess with history
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/237Pt0Y/Rtbk-kosmokrats-steam-announc-800x450.png[/img]

We all make mistakes but when you're a drone pilot building space stations in the orbit above mistakes can be extra problematic. 

While there is no fail state in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1204410/Kosmokrats/]Kosmokrats [/url]we like to offer as many different paths for players and for some perfection is their path. 

This is why we're introducing [b]History Mode[/b] or "Revisionist History Mode" as it's known by the dev team.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/bb74GH6/Rtbk-kosmokrats-gif.gif[/img]

[h1]WHAT IS HISTORY MODE?
[/h1]It basically works like a checkpoint system where you can rewind to any previous checkpoint

[img]https://i.ibb.co/W0WN4cy/2021-02-19-16-39-42-0-00-00-00.png[/img]

This lets you go back and try different approaches such as "[i]What happens if I don't save *spoiler* this time?[/i]" or "[i]I think I'll go to Jupiter instead of Mars[/i]"

If you messed up pretty badly and want to reply a mission, you can use this function to zip to the latest checkpoint. That being said, sometimes you'll have to replay X levels if you rewind to the last checkpoint.

Visually the Edit History background changes to reveal "your story", so if you upgraded VAL there'll be an image in the background showing this.

That way you can look and see a very simple "[i]this is what happened up until this point[/i]" storyboard, which we think is pretty neat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36868091/cca519c151eba9b9f9f1501d2efc6f9f648b402b.png[/img]

Give this new game mode a go and let us know what you think. Good luck out there Comrade.

notes.title: The best free demos from the Steam Autumn Festival
notes.content:
Steam returns with actual hundreds of free demos for its Autumn Festival. I am but one woman, so I could never get through them all, but I have played what I would characterise as a lot over the past two days. My own personal labour of Hercules was undertaken so that I could bring you, the reader, a list of my favourite demos to provide, if not an exhaustive list, then at least a jumping off point.

I’ve got something for all of yez, gentle pals. Puzzle games? RPGs? Action? Strategy? Why yes, even that. I’ve got an EDM murder rave, dressing up in pre-revolutionary Paris, ripping up legal documents as a cute turnip, and rodents you should live in fear of. So many games! Your favourite is sure to be among them.
